description: This Java class defines a REST controller for a notes app backend, providing endpoints for API documentation redirection, health status check, and application information.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for API documentation redirection, health checks, and application info.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /docs, redirects to Swagger UI, preserving the request's scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health, returns 'OK' indicating the application is running.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/info, returns basic application information.
